full_description: Use one arm to open the cabinet's drawer and the other arm to place the microphone from the table into the drawer. Every instruction names which arm opens the drawer.
schema: {A} notifies the microphone, {B} notifies the cabinet (use 'the drawer of {B}' or '{B}'s drawer'), {a} notifies the arm that OPENS the drawer; the other arm (literal 'the other arm'/'another arm') places {A} into the drawer. Every template contains {a}, {A} and {B}. Borrowed from native put_object_cabinet's arm-specifying templates ({a} rebound to the opening arm, which the native wording already implies).
preference: num of words should not exceed 20. {a} is the arm that opens the drawer and MUST appear in every description; the placing arm is always referred to as 'the other arm' or 'another arm'. {A} and {B} must always be mentioned.
